segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
And tell me, what do you do? Do you sleep during the day?
Do you feel sleepy during the day? Or do you sleep during the day?
Where do you sleep?
Okay.
Actually, why do I feel good talking to you? Tell me this. I don't feel shy talking to you. I talk to you openly, like we do.
Why do I feel shy with others?
Where did you go at that time?
At that time, I mean, I was in the hostel. Someone or the other comes, really.
You know, I really like talking to you, really.
It feels like I want to talk to you.
I want to get rid of my shyness by talking to you.
I will learn everything from you, okay?
Okay?
How long has it been since you got married?
How long has it been since you got married?
How long has it been since you got married?
Yes.
It has been six years.
How many children do you have? Tell me.
I have two children.
How many children?
Two.
Really? So how many years has it been since you got married? Tell me. I like talking to you.
Yes, six years, six years. Tell me.
What is it?
Okay, so what do you wear in Delhi? Do you wear a suit or a saree? What do you wear?
Don't you feel shy asking such things? Why are you asking such things?
I feel good talking to you. Like, when we talk on the phone, I don't feel shy. But when someone comes in front of me, I don't get that feeling. That's it.
What?
Are you becoming shy? Are you becoming shy?
What? What?
What?
Are you becoming shy?
No, I mean, when we talk on the phone, I don't feel shy. But if someone comes in front of me, I won't be able to do anything, really. I'm telling you this.
Yes.
Where is your husband? Is he on duty?
Leave all that. How are you?
Leave all that. How are you?
Oh, I am fine. Tell me, how can I get rid of my shyness? Tell me, where should I go? Massage parlor?
Will it go away if I go to a spa?
Shyness? Go and dip in the Ganges.
Okay, so tell me how to do it.
Listen, listen, listen, listen.
Have you ever gone to bathe in the Ganges?
No, I haven't gone. I haven't gone anywhere.
Why?
How do I check? How do I check if I can do something with a girl? Tell me.
First, answer the questions I ask you.
I haven't gone anywhere to bathe in the Ganges.
Why didn't you go?
I haven't gone yet. Everyone will go, then I will go. It's not like that.
So, who are you taking with you?
My family will go. Should I go alone? I live in a hostel. I am studying, really.
I don't think you are studying.
I live in a hostel, but what can I do? I have only one tension, that I feel shy when someone comes. Like, I spent good days and good times, but they left. I couldn't do anything.
I feel shy.
I remember that they said something and I couldn't do anything. Tell me, how much I feel shy. They said so much and I couldn't do anything. I feel so much more now.
So what is the problem? Being shy is a good thing, man.
Now that I am married, I don't know if I will be able to do anything with my wife or not.
Being shy is a good thing, it's not bad.
No, but if someone says that you have seen everything, then suppose they say something else, like 'come and sleep with me', they won't say that.
They are saying so much and I haven't done anything. You say I won't be able to do anything. I saw it while bathing.
Why don't I feel anything? In this way, I am...
It happens. It is the best thing. If you feel shy, it's a good thing. You should be shy. You should respect elders and younger ones.
You... even if your sister-in-law was older than you, she would be older in age and older in experience.
Suppose, God forbid, if her mind was not right, it doesn't matter. But at least you did your duty so that you don't do anything wrong with them.
What is bigger than that?
No, like, now that I am married, I won't be able to do anything with my wife either, because I...
I am worried about this. If any girl comes, I won't be able to do anything. Because of shyness, I won't have any sexual desire.
This is how I am. How do I check if I can do something at a spa, at a massage parlor?
See, if your nature is not bad, then don't make your nature bad. You be good. If you be good, it will be good. That is the biggest thing. And the rest...
